title: 长任务使用可恢复持久 staging，而非易失缓存
summary: 多分钟或多小时的正式任务应把中间/待发布成品放在受控、可恢复的持久 job 目录；启动前检查空间，完成后验证并交付，所有 terminal path 显式清理或保留为可恢复状态。
invariants: Formal long-job staging does not rely on browser memory or evictable cache storage.
Storage headroom is checked before expensive execution.
Staging identity is tied to a job id.
Process death/timeout leaves an explicit recoverable or cleanable job state.
Cleanup policy is explicit for success, failure, cancel and timeout.
